mentions.name: Incredible
mentions.description: A Rust Text User Interface (TUI) framework that is new, experimental, modular, declarative, event-driven, and reactive. It builds cross-platform apps from one unified code base that can be compiled for the terminal (macOS, Windows, Linux), as a standalone native window (macOS & Windows 11), or for the browser via WASM.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still changing along on Incredible (https://www.incredible.rs/) a Rust Text User Interface (TUI) Framework for the 2nd Quarter of the 21st Century.
